description: This is a test class for the PimDefinedReportDao in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for CRUD operations related to PIM-defined reports, including methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting reports. The class uses PHPUnit framework features such as test annotations, assertions, and setup methods, and interacts with various project entities and DAOs.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Report Data Access Object (DAO) related to PIM-defined reports in OrangeHRM, covering CRUD operations, report retrieval, creation, and update functionalities.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up fixture data before any tests run by populating various YAML fixture files into the database.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, including creating DAO instances and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetPimDefinedReportList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of PIM-defined reports, asserting the count and type.

methods.name: testDeletePimDefinedReportList
methods.description: Tests deletion of specific reports, asserting the number of records deleted.

methods.name: testGetPimDefinedReportById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a report by ID and checks its properties.

methods.name: testSavePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new PIM-defined report with filters and display fields, asserting the saved data.

methods.name: testUpdatePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Tests updating an existing report, modifying properties, and saving changes.
